name: Radiance Mapping
definition: A spatial feature mapping technique for point cloud rendering that simplifies the NeRF volume rendering formulation. It models the view-dependent color of the first-time intersection between an estimated surface and a camera ray, augmenting each 3D point with a learnable feature indicating first-hit color, thereby avoiding redundant computation on internal ray samples.
summary: Radiance Mapping is a lightweight point cloud rendering method that replaces volumetric density with direct latent features, avoiding redundant internal ray sampling to significantly reduce computational cost compared to NeRF.
